[u][b]The Genius Scientist Oppai Spy Mama![/b][/u]
Race: Human
Code Name: 000 (Triple-O)
Libido and Lewdness Level: 3.8 / 5.0
Masturbation Frequency: Normal

The creator of Septem, an android, and a magitech scientist. She is also a teacher at the spy academy, and her codename is “000” (Triple-O). Her boobs are a bountiful Q-cup, and apparently she finds it troublesome how sweat gathers in her cleavage while she works.

She is a well-known figure even within Lukwofort, and calls herself a genius scientist. She has developed countless spy gadgets, many of which have continued to be used by the nation’s intelligence agents for years. She constantly wears a high-performance headgear device of her own creation, which often surprises those meeting her for the first time. She is continually compared to Parthia Ramsey, the magitech scientist from the maid kingdom Fifresia, and as a result has come to view her as an intense rival.

Her subjects are science and gadget development. Since she designs and develops gadgets suited to the needs of each student, she is considered very reliable. However, some people seem to think she is an eccentric mad scientist.

One thing impossible to avoid when speaking about her is how completely different her personality becomes depending on whether she is wearing her headgear or not. When wearing it, she becomes overflowing with confidence and acts eccentric, while without it she lacks confidence and becomes timid and nervous. Since she was weak-willed and cowardly from a young age, it seems she came to believe that by blocking out the gaze of others with the headgear, she could become a different person. Incidentally, the personality she adopts at those times closely resembles Parthia, suggesting that despite seeing her as a rival, she has also been deeply influenced by her.

Her relationship with Septem, whom she treats like a daughter, is extremely good. The two happily continue their research and development together, and to outsiders they appear even closer than a real parent and child. Incidentally, the reason Septem is cool and self-confident is because Amber designed her to possess the kind of personality she herself wished she had.

Toward the protagonist who came from another world, she is fascinated from the very beginning. She wants to conduct all kinds of research on him as a test subje… specimen. She is also fond of him because he treats her without prejudice.

Her hobbies are gadget development, research, and adding new functions to Septem. The things she dislikes are having her headgear removed, and being compared to Parthia.
